claim: In E1M1 (sprite 505, a clock) and E2M4 (sprite 275, a mirror) a clock face or mirror does not fall to pieces as a thing: it is a one-way switch that answers a bullet (trigger_vector), shown in its next picture when its state changes (1165 becomes the smashed clock 1166, 710 the broken mirror 711), and it fires an unseen kThingObjectGib where it hangs (E1M1 506, E2M4 879), which throws the glass and makes the noise.
evidence: E1M1 sprites 505 (kSwitchOneWay, picnum 1165, tx 147) and 506 (type 416, invisible, rx 147); E2M4 sprites 275 (kSwitchOneWay, picnum 710, tx 153) and 879 (type 416, invisible, rx 153)
NBlood/source/blood/src/view.cpp:2735-2737 (viewProcessSprites): a toggle or one-way switch draws picnum+1 while its state is 1
use: Wire a breakable wall fixture as a shot one-way switch sending to a hidden kThingObjectGib.
